research.facts:
September 1 Recruiting Window
**Sources searched:** nfca.org, 12sportsconsulting.com, nextcommit.ai, ncsasports.org
**Confirmed facts (HIGH confidence):**
- September 1 = **first day D1 softball coaches can call, text, or meet off-campus** with Class of 2028 recruits
- Class of 2028 = current high school juniors (rising class entering junior year)
- Since **June 15**: D1 coaches could send printed materials and some electronic communication only
- The September 1 rule was specifically passed by the NCAA for softball recruiting
- Programs that call early in September signal the recruit is a top priority
- Junior year is universally the peak D1 communication window for softball recruits
- **14 days away** from August 18, 2026
**No new specific 2028 commits surfaced** in searches as of Aug 18, 2026.

- Brisbane Finals = **LA28 Olympic qualifier**
- 16-player roster for the Group Stage

- 7 athletes from 2025 World Games gold medal squad
- 10 athletes competed in 2025 USA Down Under Series
- **Oklahoma leads all schools: 4 players** — Alyssa Brito, Jayda Coleman, Tiare Jennings, Kelly Maxwell
- Roster announced July 1, 2026 (usasoftball.com)
